slots.supply_status: Component supply is tight across the board: lead times are stretching and MOSFETs in particular are short, though Delta's purchasing scale and supplier relationships keep demand largely fulfilled. Supplier price increases will be negotiated and passed to customers where the business model allows, with a timing lag.

slots.next_catalyst: Management endorsed as 'a fair characterization' the view that high-capacitance MLCC demand ramping alongside next-generation AI servers will force conversion of mid/low-end capacity and put shortage pressure on the rest of the portfolio - part of its customer conversations already cover securing that non-AI piece too, with peers also raising MLCC utilization. Adjacent driver: the whole AI power chain 'from the grid down to the rack of the server' has many voltage step-down/conversion stages needing filtering and ripple-current management, driving strong growth in film capacitors and aluminum electrolytic capacitors plus the magnetics (inductors) and connector lines - embedded across computing, industrial and telecom segments. In notebooks, new tantalum packaging offering higher capacitance in a smaller package positions a laptop recovery as more of a 2027 story.

slots.guidance: Director of Finance Joseph Hsia: royalty revenue is expected to accelerate in Q3 and the second half of 2026 - several advanced-node products, including ADAS, AI accelerators, SSDs and networking, have begun entering mass production, and foundry wafer prices are gradually increasing. Chairman Charles Hsu: licensing will continue its strong momentum; royalty growth is expected to accelerate on higher ASP from new advanced-node applications, new application ramps, an expanding PUF royalty contribution and a growing mix of higher-royalty-rate MTP applications.
slots.supply_status: Director of Finance Joseph Hsia: Q2 royalty corresponds to foundry production in Q1, when mature-node foundry capacity utilization remained at a relatively low level and some customers went through seasonal inventory adjustment; from Q2 overall foundry capacity utilization began to improve.
slots.next_catalyst: Chairman Charles Hsu: 1T Flash (NeoFlash / Logic Flash) is in platform development and verification with several foundry partners, each progressing according to plan; customers may begin mass production next year. Standalone development focuses first on NOR Flash; after foundry partners bring standalone NOR Flash into mass production, eMemory may extend 1T Flash into a NAND Flash architecture.
